# Lake Minnetonka Probate

> Lake Minnetonka Probate is Geoffrey Serdar's site for families handling an inherited or estate home in Minnesota. Geoffrey is a licensed Minnesota real estate agent with Serdar+Partners at Compass. He works with personal representatives, families and their attorneys around Lake Minnetonka and in Hennepin and Carver Counties, including Minneapolis. He works by service area and does not list a street address. Phone: 952-258-3100.

He handles the real estate side of an estate: what to do with the house, whether to keep, lease or sell it, and how to sell it. He does not give legal advice; that stays with the family's attorney.

## Pages

- [Lake Minnetonka Probate](https://lakeminnetonkaprobate.com/): how Geoffrey helps with an inherited or estate home
- [The house checklist](https://lakeminnetonkaprobate.com/checklist/): practical things to handle with an estate home before anything is decided
- [Keep it in the family](https://lakeminnetonkaprobate.com/keep-or-sell/): options for pausing, leasing or holding an inherited home
